Formula For a nonempty track, p=I(a,b,t); speed=d(a,b)/duration only when active with positive duration, otherwise 0. I is linear interpolation in planar mode or spherical interpolation with continuous longitude. Binary search picks the latest duplicate row; t is the clamped elapsed-time fraction, held at 0 in a gap and at the endpoint outside the span. Empty tracks output zeros.

For a nonempty track, p=I(a,b,t); speed=d(a,b)/duration only when active with positive duration, otherwise 0. I is linear interpolation in planar mode or spherical interpolation with continuous longitude. Binary search picks the latest duplicate row; t is the clamped elapsed-time fraction, held at 0 in a gap and at the endpoint outside the span. Empty tracks output zeros.
